description: Read custom domains without running a DNS check: status, `problem`, DNS records and the publication shown. No address: every custom domain of the profile plus how many it holds and may hold. With type, namespace and id, or with hostname: that one custom domain.

hostname.description: Custom domain as a bare hostname, e.g. www.example.com; instead of type, namespace and id

ownerToken.description: Whole list or by hostname: an admin profile token. By publication: a profile token or an owner token added to the profile. Default: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN (local server only).

type.description: Publication type; with namespace and id, instead of hostname

name: list_domains
title: List custom domains
